lines: 2 files are not reproducible: two builds of the same source wrote different bytes.

Nothing about this checkout follows from a difference in them, so they carry no verdict above. What a build writes that it does not derive from the source - a timestamp, a random name, something taken from the directory it ran in - is where this comes from.
npm ci and npm run build succeed on the tracked files alone, twice, in 57 s.
Nothing else was in the tree, which is the state a fresh clone and CI build in, so a build that needs a leftover from an earlier one would have failed here.
Every file in js/ is what this source builds, leaving aside the 2 files above that no build reproduces.
